maturities.experimental: Implemented behind an explicit experimental boundary
maturities.agent_guided: Requires agent judgment and project context

resultStates.suspected: A lead that still needs context or reproduction.
resultStates.unknown: The check or evidence source was unavailable or incomplete. In source CLI runs, exit 3 means the tool refuses a clean result because evidence is incomplete; it is not a vulnerability count.
resultStates.not_applicable: Outside the recorded scope or absent from the project.

capabilities.name: Crawl-boundary audit
capabilities.scope: Checks robots, sitemap, crawler accessibility, soft-404 behavior and optional authorized sensitive-path probes.

capabilities.name: Crawler identity verification
capabilities.scope: Verifies an exact crawler product through published ranges or matching forward-confirmed reverse DNS; a user-agent string is never sufficient.

capabilities.name: Edge hardening verification
capabilities.scope: Checks security headers, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, certificate validation and TLS policy; bounded rate-limit traffic is separately authorized.

capabilities.name: Narrow deterministic source audit
capabilities.scope: Runs 25 stable built-in risk rules and 3 evidence-integrity rules: five shared repository/configuration checks plus ten bounded JavaScript/TypeScript and ten bounded Python leads. Pattern matches remain suspected; only narrow Git and manifest facts can be confirmed, and this is not whole-program SAST. Deterministic per-file token/operation and whole-run operation budgets fail closed as incomplete evidence.

capabilities.name: Framework-aware route, action and control inventory
capabilities.scope: Produces route-security v2 artifacts for bounded Express, NestJS and Next.js App Router syntax, with Next.js Server Actions as a separate non-HTTP surface. Stable Express syntax covers variable-bound ESM/CommonJS factories, direct require('express').Router(), inline routes, exact static mounts and exact local CommonJS router mounts. A structurally observed imported local registration function remains unsupported and fails closed as partial/unknown evidence. Application controls are listed once, authentication and authorization signals are separated, and routes with no observed route-scoped control remain review states rather than vulnerability findings.

capabilities.name: Bounded identity-to-data access-control chain
capabilities.scope: For supported routes and Server Actions, records exact Nest Passport or Auth.js identity evidence and caller-selected object flow into bounded Prisma or Drizzle operations in the same handler or through one exact project-local call. Static module aliases resolve only to one source target and analysis stops before a second call. A missing visible constraint remains review evidence and cannot prove BOLA/IDOR; the capped ordinary-project review produced 12 partial and zero completed chains.

capabilities.name: Experimental Clerk, Better Auth and Supabase access evidence
capabilities.scope: Recognizes exact bounded Clerk, Better Auth and Supabase identity constructs plus Supabase Query Builder operations. These families lack sufficient ordinary-project evidence for stable promotion; every Supabase operation retains external_policy_required because source analysis cannot evaluate deployed Postgres RLS.

capabilities.name: AWS exposure inventory helper
capabilities.scope: Runs a read-only, permission-aware AWS inventory helper. Denied, missing or malformed evidence becomes explicit v2 unknown coverage and never a fabricated posture finding.

capabilities.name: Gitleaks secret detection adapter
capabilities.scope: Opt-in Gitleaks 8.30.1 adapter for Git history and working-tree secret-pattern leads. Matches remain suspected until credential validity/exposure is established; evidence persists rule/location and digested fingerprints, never secret values.

capabilities.name: OSV-Scanner dependency vulnerability adapter
capabilities.scope: Opt-in OSV-Scanner 2.5.0 adapter for recorded lockfile advisory matches. Matches remain suspected until project impact is established; evidence preserves advisory identity and upstream severity without local inflation.

capabilities.name: Opengrep source data-flow adapter
capabilities.scope: Opt-in Opengrep 1.27.0 adapter with ten project-owned, digest-pinned same-file request-to-command, SQL, outbound-URL, file-path and redirect taint rules for JavaScript/TypeScript and Python. It is not a general rules catalogue or whole-program SAST; every match remains suspected.

capabilities.name: Bounded Checkov deployment-policy adapter
capabilities.scope: Opt-in Checkov 3.3.9 adapter limited to CKV_DOCKER_8 and CKV_DOCKER_2 on the root Dockerfile plus CKV2_GHA_1 on root .github/workflows YAML. Matches remain suspected deployment-policy leads. Compose, Terraform, Kubernetes and the rest of Checkov are not stable coverage.

capabilities.name: Local before/after demo
capabilities.scope: Runs the real v3 source audit against an intentionally unsafe local Node.js fixture, explains one suspected command-execution lead, records a reviewable shell-free patch, then runs a compatible security retest and a separate functional retest without network access.

capabilities.name: Automatic project discovery and scoped run
capabilities.scope: Detects supported Node/Python and split-stack projects, package managers, lockfiles and config/deployment paths, then creates a versioned network-free security scope. It never establishes deployment ownership.

capabilities.name: Git diff source-audit selection
capabilities.scope: Reduces built-in source-audit review noise with added-line --since selection or an isolated --staged Git index snapshot. It records the immutable base and selection counts, preserves relevant incomplete evidence, excludes external adapters and cannot establish whole-repository safety or baseline/retest state.

capabilities.name: No-download deep audit profile
capabilities.scope: Expands one audit command to the built-in detector plus Checkov, Gitleaks, Opengrep and OSV-Scanner in stable order. It never downloads a tool; every missing, incompatible or failed external adapter remains explicit unknown evidence with doctor guidance.

capabilities.name: Reproducible rule-contract conformance
capabilities.scope: Regenerates exact JSON and Markdown pass/fail evidence for 25 built-in risk and three evidence-integrity planted positive/negative rule contracts. It is author-maintained conformance evidence, not a production-vulnerability precision, recall, reachability, exploitability or security-coverage measurement.

capabilities.name: Historical real-world regression corpus
capabilities.scope: Re-executes four minimized historical correctness failures and one review-visible benign DOM-sink match against product code. It guards named regressions and does not provide representative production-vulnerability accuracy.

capabilities.name: Stable multi-format finding reports
capabilities.scope: Renders source v3 and crawl, demo, crawler-identity, edge and AWS v2 conclusions as JSON, Markdown, escaped HTML, SARIF 2.1.0 and JUnit while preserving domain, evidence state, baseline state and fingerprints. Technical evidence is recursively sanitized across report-bundle artifacts using normalized credential-key nouns and bounded high-confidence value formats; generic metadata remains visible. This is leak prevention for the evidence contract, not a complete secret scanner. Legacy v1 remains historical input only.

capabilities.name: Patch and baseline retest evidence loop
capabilities.scope: Writes patch-only proposals, explains source findings and compares persisted v2 or v3 baselines with subject/scope/rule identity, per-rule coverage and honest new/fixed/unchanged/regressed/unretested/not_comparable states.

capabilities.name: Professional and plain-language finding explanation
capabilities.scope: Source report v3 gives every finding a technical term, ordinary-language meaning, realistic consequence, evidence boundary, reviewable proposal, alternatives, side effects, required decisions, separate security and functional retests, and rollback criteria. Default display omits raw evidence; the technical view is explicit.

capabilities.name: Reviewable security repair workflow
capabilities.scope: Creates a private, review-only repair record for one source v3 finding. It preserves evidence state separately from repair progress, requires explicit approval before application, blocks unknown evidence from application, and requires both security and functional retests before a repair can be recorded as retested. The CLI does not edit project files.

capabilities.name: npm, plugin, installer and GitHub Action distribution
capabilities.scope: Runs the same runtime through npm/npx and a Claude plugin marketplace, installs Claude Code, Codex and CLI surfaces with conflict preflight/backups, and runs a composite Action with backward-compatible crawl mode plus built-in or caller-provided source adapters.

capabilities.name: Frontend exposure review
capabilities.scope: Guides source/build-artifact review for secrets, source maps, endpoints, client-side trust and CSP. It is not a general automatic frontend scanner.

capabilities.name: API and business-logic review
capabilities.scope: Guides scoped review of authentication, object/function authorization, abuse controls, races, injection, SSRF and data exposure.

capabilities.name: LLM and OAuth/OIDC review
capabilities.scope: Guides context-dependent review of prompt injection, cost abuse, tool permissions, OAuth state/PKCE and identity linking.

capabilities.name: Server code and data-layer review
capabilities.scope: Guides source and architecture review for dangerous sinks, authorization coverage, secret handling, tenant isolation, least privilege, backup and integrity.

capabilities.name: Supply-chain and detection review
capabilities.scope: Guides dependency, browser script, container, CI/CD, logging, alerting and incident-response review; existing release SBOM generation covers this repository only.

capabilities.name: AWS posture review
capabilities.scope: Guides contextual review of IAM, network, storage, logging and workload controls beyond the narrow read-only inventory helper.
